title: Ultimate Pipe Game
source_topic: ICPC / The 2016 ACM - Asia Nha Trang Regional Contest
statement: Every empty cell of a grid up to 20 by 20 must receive exactly one pipe: a straight horizontal one, a straight vertical one, or a freely rotatable curved one, and the pipe ends must join so that all water circulates in closed loops with no leaks. Straight pipes carry per-cell costs; the task is the cheapest valid layout, or a report that none exists.
